snippet.title: It's FINALLY Happening... The NEW Release Date for Dark Scrolls
snippet.description:
Ok ACTUALLY launching this time for PC & Nintendo Switch on June 22!
Stop scrollin' and wishlist Dark Scrolls: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912550/Dark_Scrolls/

http://www.darkscrolls.com

The pixel-perfect developers over at Doinksoft are stoked to reveal that Dark Scrolls launches for PC and Nintendo Switch on June 22! This fantasy-themed action platformer fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.

Choose from a hefty cast of playable characters - including an axe-throwing warrior, a spell-slinging magician, a knife-hurling thief, or weirder heroes like a cute dog, an alien, or a rat playing a saxophone - and test your skills solo or in local or online co-op.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
